result.one_liner: Otter AI is a meeting transcription and note-taking platform that converts audio conversations into searchable transcripts with AI-powered summaries and action items.

evidence.quote: All API requests require authentication using Bearer token authentication
Otter offers a public API for Enterprise customers. To get started, you need to contact your Otter account manager to enable access
Otter.ai's Public API provides programmatic access to retrieve channels, conversations, transcripts, audio, action items, insights, outlines
With Otter's MCP Server, these AI assistants can search your meeting transcripts across all time periods, analyze patterns and themes

result.notes: Otter AI has both a REST API and an official MCP server. The REST API is limited to Enterprise plan customers only, requiring contact with an account manager to enable. Self-serve API key generation is available after onboarding. The MCP server provides OAuth-authenticated access with granular permissions for AI assistants.
